Docs.param: The event id to resume strictly after, or for all retained items.
Docs.summary: Returns an async iterator over emitted items. With a replay backing, resumes strictly after the retained item whose equals it (the reconnection primitive); a value yields all retained items, and an id no longer in the retained window replays all retained items (best-effort, matching SSE Last-Event-ID semantics). It is silently ignored by a live (non-replay) backing, which has no history.
Docs.returns: An asynchronous sequence of event items.
